mysql_user.description: Username for the MySQL database used for DHCP lease storage and control.

mysql_password.description: Password for the MySQL database. Leave blank only if using peer authentication.

mysql_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the MySQL server.

mysql_database.description: Name of the MySQL database used by Kea DHCP.

mysql_port.description: Port number of the MySQL server.

control_socket_path.description: Unix socket path for Kea DHCP control commands (e.g., for 'kea-dhcp4-ctrl-agent').

dhcp_queue_size.description: Size of the DHCP packet processing queue. Increase for high-throughput deployments.

lease_cmds_lib_path.description: Path to the lease commands hook library (required for API-based lease management).

ddns_lib_path.description: Path to the DDNS hook library. Only used if dynamic DNS updates are enabled.

enable_ddns.description: Enable dynamic DNS (forward and reverse) updates for assigned addresses.

ddns_ttl.description: Default TTL (seconds) for DNS records created via DDNS.

ddns_server_ip.description: IP address of the DNS server to receive DDNS updates (must support TSIG).

ddns_server_port.description: Port of the DNS server for DDNS updates.

ddns_qualifying_suffix.description: Domain suffix to append to hostnames for FQDNs when DDNS is enabled.

interfaces.description: List of network interfaces (by name) on which Kea DHCP will listen and respond to requests. For DHCPv4, 'raw' sockets are used if dhcp-socket-type is 'raw', otherwise 'unix' for UDP/TCP over UDP. The value 'all' can be used to listen on all interfaces.

lease_lfc_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between cleanup of expired leases from the database.

renew_time.description: Time (seconds) after lease issuance when client may attempt renewal.

rebind_time.description: Time (seconds) after lease issuance when client must attempt rebinding if renewal fails.

valid_lifetime.description: Default validity lifetime (seconds) for IPv4 addresses assigned by this server.

log_output.description: Where to send log messages. Can be a file path (e.g., '/var/log/kea-dhcp4.log') or special values like 'stdout', 'stderr'.

log_severity.description: Minimum log severity (DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, FATAL). Use INFO or DEBUG for troubleshooting.

log_debuglevel.description: Debug verbosity level (0–99). Higher values produce more logs. Only effective for DEBUG severity.

subnets.description: List of IPv4 subnets managed by this Kea server. Each defines a network, IP range, and client options.
